digest.component_or_area: ADR / testing architecture / Gerrit Verify CI workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently executes complete real-Pandoc corpus replay on macOS critical path, consuming 184+ seconds per run.
ADR 0095 mandates real-Pandoc process for every conversion assertion, preventing test boundary relocation without decision supersession.
Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay must move from Gerrit Verify hot path to a dedicated external-integration.yml job matrix covering both ubuntu-latest and macos-latest.
Gerrit Verify must retain three representative live corpus bodies (code_arrow, table, prose) and compact provenance probes with committed deterministic output assertions.
External-integration.yml workflow is currently Ubuntu-only and requires implementation of a new pandoc-corpus-replay matrix with explicit platform support.
